Real Quest source-change/select/squeeze and Android transient touchscreen source-change/select through both listener styles. Live event poses, event viewer-pose rejection, retained-frame rejection after callbacks/exceptions, unchanged processing, complete asynchronous singular end delivery.

Cross-realm genuine sessions, frames and sources from iframe and popup accepted in constructors in both directions. Forged/proxy values rejected. Mixed-session, ended-session and inactive-frame data accepted without activation or ownership prerequisites.

Synthetic select/end/source-change dispatch on inline targets has no virtual-input or session-lifecycle side effects. Existing input-lifecycle suite also exercises two phone screen-mouse gestures and shutdown during real actions.
